_comment: Curated, anonymized pre-breach fingerprints derived from PUBLIC breach disclosures (Phase H, Security DNA). Each entry describes security indicators that were present BEFORE a well-documented breach campaign. Reference/analytical use only. Weights are relative importance of each matching factor.

patterns.name: MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation (Cl0p, 2023)
patterns.summary: Internet-exposed managed file transfer app with a SQL injection zero-day (CVE-2023-34362) exploited for mass data theft.

patterns.name: Log4Shell opportunistic exploitation (2021-2022)
patterns.summary: Java web apps logging untrusted input via Log4j2 (CVE-2021-44228) allowed JNDI-based RCE at massive scale.

patterns.name: Exchange ProxyLogon chain (HAFNIUM, 2021)
patterns.summary: On-prem Microsoft Exchange servers exposed to the internet, chained SSRF + write (CVE-2021-26855 et al) for webshells.

patterns.name: SolarWinds Orion supply-chain (2020)
patterns.summary: Network-management platform with internet-exposed web console and privileged reach across the estate.

patterns.name: Citrix Bleed NetScaler (CVE-2023-4966, 2023)
patterns.summary: Internet-facing NetScaler ADC/Gateway leaking session tokens, used for session hijacking and ransomware staging.

patterns.name: Legacy web application with weak crypto (generic high-risk profile)
patterns.summary: Outdated web stack with deprecated TLS, missing security headers and old CMS versions — the common pre-breach baseline for opportunistic attacks.
